I got sick of being the AAA of the high seas. It got to the point that fisherman would call us for a tow to save on fuel going back in. I was the Quartermaster and stood OOD watch. I re upped and got $10,000 for 3 years. Did another year in Santa Barbara and got sent to VTS Governors Island. IT SUCKED. We never really had to much trouble with people. Wow Port Oconnor was a long ways from anywhere. In 77 we recieved a new 41 that was a sweet boat. All that was a long time back as they say.
